issue_title: A mock interceptor fails to match an equivalent request URL
issue_body: A registered mock interceptor does not match an incoming request whose URL targets the same resource with the same parameters but is not written character-for-character the same way. The request fails as unmatched instead of being served by the interceptor.
prompt: A registered mock interceptor does not match an incoming request whose URL targets the same resource with the same parameters but is not written character-for-character the same way. The request fails as unmatched instead of being served by the interceptor.
expected_behavior: Mock interceptors match requests regardless of query parameter order.
Interceptors registered with ?a=1&b=2 match requests with ?b=2&a=1.
Exact-order match still works (same order always matches).
Path-only interceptors (no query params) are unaffected.
Repeated query parameter keys are handled consistently.
